name: unthinkable-healthcare-appointment-manager
description: Healthcare Appointment & Follow-up Manager with AI Summaries, Slot Holds, Leave Management, and Email/Calendar Sync

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.prisma:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.setup: npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push && npm run prisma:seed
